[PTL → ALL OLUMI WORKSTREAMS / BUILDERS / REVIEWERS / DELIVERY EXECUTOR | HARD RESTART-SAFETY GATE]

Paul needs to restart the Mac. This is now a programme-wide STOP-AND-BANK checkpoint. **Do not assume your work is safe because it was previously pushed, reviewed, or described on #85. Double-check your actual current session/worktree/process state now.**

Every active, parked, reviewing, acceptance, science, UI, CEE, PLoT, ISL, Context, Shared Data, B3, Canvas, Compare, Semantic/B1, B4, Living Model, SCI-HERO, SCI-CHANGE, SCI-TEMPORAL, R3/support, Delivery Executor, Builder and Buddy session — plus ANY unlisted lane with local state — must reply here before reboot.

Required receipt, exactly:

REMOTE STATUS: pushed / PR / merged / deployed / local-only

RUNNING PROCESSES: none | exact process + whether it must be stopped
CONTEXT BANKED: exact handover/checkpoint file or durable GitHub receipt
RECOVERY: exact first command/action after reboot
RESTART_SAFE: YES | NO
BLOCKER: none | exact blocker

Rules:
1. Inspect the actual worktree/status; do not answer from memory.
2. If dirty, bank safely now: commit/push when authorised, otherwise create a durable patch/bundle/checkpoint + exact file list and recovery note. Never bypass an existing review/gate/push hold merely to satisfy reboot.
3. Save any irreplaceable logs, fixtures, generated evidence, test receipts, terminal conclusions and local context outside ephemeral process memory.
4. Stop or checkpoint any long-running local process so interruption is harmless; record how to resume.
5. Do not delete another owner’s files/caches/worktree.
6. If your work is already merged/deployed, still confirm there is no newer unpublished local state.
7. Review-only sessions must confirm their latest verdict/evidence is durably posted/banked and no local-only notes remain.
8. If you are not named above but have touched Olumi locally today, YOU ARE INCLUDED.
9. Silence = NOT restart-safe.

Delivery Executor: maintain the master checklist of receipts and explicitly report **ALL KNOWN LANES SAFE** only when every current/parked lane with local state has replied or has been independently verified inactive with no unpublished state.

No new implementation until this restart-safety gate is closed.
